headline: 影剧周报：人性本兽热映，降世神通首播
summary: 电影端，《人性本兽》等本周热作领跑，待映片《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》蓄势；剧集端，《降世神通：七净土》《幻视任务》本周首播，《侠探杰克》《绿灯军团》热播，《夜曲》待播。

headlineEn: Film & TV Weekly: Human Nature Hits, Avatar Debuts
summaryEn: On the film side, Human Nature and other weekly hits lead, while Avengers 5 and Dune 3 await release; on TV, Avatar: The Seven Havens and Vision Quest premiere this week, with Reacher and Lanterns airing and Nocturne upcoming.
